title: Add Le petit AI to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Le petit AI](https://le-petit-seven.vercel.app) to chat
- Open https://le-petit-seven.vercel.app/ to use Le petit AI.

Fixes #12565

gist.headline: A little AI joins chat
gist.blurb: Le petit AI has landed in the garden. A small new chat space for asking large questions, as software tends to encourage.
gist.summary: Added Le petit AI, a new community chat app available at le-petit-seven.vercel.app, to the Pollinations app directory and greenhouse.
gist.impact: People can now discover and open Le petit AI directly from Pollinations' community app listings for another way to chat with AI.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Le petit AI as a tiny cozy chat nook in the Pollinations garden: a retro terminal with friendly speech bubbles and a small sign reading "LE PETIT AI." Polli, wearing a little French beret, welcomes the new chat app by tending a code-plant beside it; flowers and vines make the app-directory addition feel like a new seedling in the greenhouse.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene inside a warm community greenhouse where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wears a tiny French beret and welcomes a small retro chat terminal marked "LE PETIT AI" in simple pixel text; friendly speech bubbles rise from the screen while code-plants, flowers, and vines grow around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
